ui_source_explanations.forge: Gameplay building: Forge is the upgradable crafting workshop. Do not translate this label as the act of forging or a tattoo.
ui_source_explanations.craftOpenEliteSlotDialog: Gameplay verb: "forge" means to craft or process treasures. It does not name the Forge building.
ui_source_explanations.craftClosedRecipeTitle: Gameplay building: the forge is the upgradable crafting workshop, not the act of forging or a tattoo.
ui_source_explanations.craftClosedRecipeDescription: Gameplay building: both "Forge Level" and "forge of legends" refer to the upgradable crafting workshop. Neither occurrence means the act of forging or a tattoo.
ui_source_explanations.upgradeCraftRecipesStatDescription: Gameplay verb: "forge" means to craft items. It does not name the Forge building.
ui_source_explanations.storageUpgradeDescription: Gameplay verb: "forged" describes treasures that were crafted. It does not name the Forge building.
ui_source_explanations.craftSlotDescription: Gameplay verb: "forge" means to craft a piece of jewelry. It does not name the Forge building.

tutorial_source_explanations.DialogueClaimedChestCharacter1: Gameplay building: "magic forge" is the crafting workshop. It can transform items; it is not the act of forging or a tattoo.
tutorial_source_explanations.tip9: Gameplay building: the player upgrades the Forge crafting workshop to unlock recipes.
